OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be valid for the
            city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no
            known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^\d{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form:
            a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits;
            spaces, dashes and brackets are ignored. Rejected unless 8 to 15 digits
            remain after the '+'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: "^[-+()\\d ]+$"
          example: '0412 345 678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth. Optional. When present, the owner's 'ageBand'
            is derived from it, measured against the registration date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted. Must not be later than the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
          x-field-extra-annotation: '@jakarta.validation.constraints.PastOrPresent'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Request-only flag. When true, allows creating an owner who shares another
            owner's last name and address instead of rejecting it as a household duplicate.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true

              title: Display name

              readOnly: true

              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'

              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                Assigned customer code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>': the upper-cased first three

              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'SMI-0007'
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable identifier shared by every owner in the same household (same last name

              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners sharing this owner's first and last name
                (compared case-insensitively) at the time this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                Assigned membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the
                last two digits of the registration date's year.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                Numeric membership level from 1 to 3, assigned on creation: starts at 1,

                namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), capped at 3.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              readOnly: true
              example: 3
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city via a fixed city-to-region

              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW'
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email address is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'EMAIL'
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from their birth date, measured against the
                registration date: 'MINOR' (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65+).
                Absent when no birth date was supplied.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'ADULT'
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been registered today at the time
                this owner was created, signalling an unusually high daily signup volume.
              type: boolean
              default: false
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                Derived duplicate-detection key formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId':
                the telephone reduced to its digits, the lower-cased email (empty when absent), and
                the household id. Two owners are the same registration only when these keys match.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|A1B2C3D4E5F6'
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the decimal digits of the
                customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              readOnly: true
              example: 7
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, although not a hard duplicate, shares an existing owner's

              type: boolean
              default: false
              readOnly: true

              title: Possible duplicate of

              example: 7

## Summary

The `householdId` is now deterministic from `(normalizedLastName, postcode)`, and everything keyed off the household uses that computed id. Changes were kept as small, cohesive edits in low-complexity util/support classes so the large controller barely moved.

- **`util/Household.java`** — `idFor` now takes an `Owner` and hashes `normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode` (was `lastName|address`). Single source of truth for the id; still 12 upper-case hex chars of SHA-256.
- **`mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — one expression updated to `Household.idFor(owner)`.
- **`util/GoldTier.java`** — household-size check routed through the computed id (`Household.idFor(owner)` / `idFor(o)`).
- **`rest/advice/DuplicateHouseholdException.java`** — `rejectIfDuplicate` now detects duplicates by comparing computed `householdId` (same last name + postcode), still bypassed by `sharesHousehold`. Dropped the now-dead local normalization.
- **`util/PossibleDuplicate.java`** — `assign` takes `sharesHousehold`; a declared household member is never flagged as a suspected duplicate.
- **`rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — reads `sharesHousehold` once, adds the household-duplicate rejection (409 unless the flag is set), and passes the flag to `PossibleDuplicate.assign`.

Behavior now matches the spec: two owners with the same last name and postcode share a `householdId` automatically; a second such owner is a 409 household duplicate unless it sets `sharesHousehold`, in which case it's created as a declared member and not marked a possible duplicate.
